title: Location: an explorable grid map (ADR 0009, docs/contracts/locations.md)

watch.description: F8: the guard who answers a crime here (an npc id), or "" for nobody. Unset: the region's watch (story/crime.gd WATCH).

ceiling_ft.description: The ceiling's height in feet, which flyers can't rise above. Default: 20 indoors, the open sky outdoors.

elevation.description: The lie of the land under the rows (natural ground): a string per row, a character per square, '0'-'9' then 'a'-'z' for 0 to 175 ft in 5 ft steps ('.' or a space: no rise). Neighbouring natural squares 5 ft apart are a gentle slope, 10 ft a steep one, 15 ft or more a cliff.

drop_ft.description: How far the open void beside the floor falls (a chasm, a tower's well): a creature forced over the edge falls this far and out of the fight. Without it, the void is the map's edge and nothing crosses it.

sight.description: The place's own sight rules in a fight (EncounterSight): mist, spore clouds, an oppressive gloom.

light_scale.description: Every light's reach is scaled by this (0.5: half).

darkvision_cap.description: Darkvision reaches no farther than this.

sight_ft.description: Heavily Obscured beyond this: nothing farther is seen (senses aside).

names.description: Creature names or stat block ids.

when.description: A story condition: the rules hold only while it does (until a beacon is lit).

swim.description: Its deep water (w) can be swum in fights: double cost without a Swim Speed; water-only creatures stay in it (docs/reference/contracts/locations.md).

cells.description: Two corners of a rectangle, inclusive.

floor.description: The room's floor: a texture surface, theme/surface in art/textures/manifest.json (docs/art/set_dressing.md). Optional; otherwise the catalog's room rules or the map's theme decide.

walls.description: The room's walls: a texture surface, theme/surface in art/textures/manifest.json. Optional.

raised.description: true: this area's own `floor` shows on raised ground too (ArenaBoard draws it only at 0 ft otherwise): the Amber Temple's vestibule and guardrooms, whose ledge stands 25 ft up.

furnish.description: false: the furnishing pass (world/look/furnish.gd) leaves this room to its own props, for a room its text calls bare, plain or kept clean. A name: furnish it from that set in the catalog's furnish `sets` instead of by its kind (a burned hall's debris). Default true.

private.description: F8: the npc whose private room this is. Seen inside, the party is told to leave; seen again, it's trespass.

open.description: F8: when a private room may be entered (a condition, docs/contracts/dialogue.md), e.g. "day".

antimagic.description: An antimagic area (Van Richten's Tower's ring, Dungeon Expansion Plan V1): no spell is cast on a square in it, from the character sheet (Wards.antimagic_at, FieldCasting) or in a fight there (an Antimagic Field zone over its open squares, LocationFights._ward_the_fight). A string is the notice shown to a caster who tries.

hazard.description: Ground that harms whoever stays in it in a fight (AreaHazards): a pool of blood, a bog of rot.

only_difficult.description: Only the squares the map draws as Difficult Terrain (~) are in it: a moat round a dry island.

on.description: When it bites: the end of a turn in it (default) or the start.

while_in.description: The condition lasts only while the creature stays in it (default true).

crowd.description: Bystanders milling about this area (Crowds): figures that aren't NPCs and never block; with push_to, they jostle the party toward that square while it stands here.

sprites.description: The figures' art (stand-ins until the place has its own).

foe_spots.description: A road battle ground (a random encounter table's or a road's `grounds`): where foes may start when a fight from another table plays out here. Open squares three or more from the default spawn, in cover or up high; each foe takes the free spot nearest where its table put it round the party (story/road_grounds.gd).

sets_quest.description: Taking this exit moves a quest on, like a conversation's `quest` line, but only from the listed stages ("" is not started): the way into a place a quest sends the party must leave the quest where its own talk would.

when.description: The door opens only while this condition holds; until then it won't budge (a portcullis raised by a story flag).

unlocked_when.description: While this condition holds the door's lock is off, so it opens like an unlocked door (the church undercroft's bar, once Donavich lifts it); until then it can be unlocked as any lock can.

locked_text.description: What the Narrator says, and the menu's reason, when the door won't open because its `when` doesn't hold (default: It won't budge).

leaf.description: "none": the door draws no leaf and no frame (a ward whose look is a prop on its square, the guardians' curtain of light); it still blocks and opens as a door.

checks.description: Skill checks on this thing outside fights and conversations (story/world_checks.gd, docs/story/world_checks.md).

stand_ft.description: Creatures stand on this prop's squares (its cell, or all its span) this many feet above the ground: a podium, a platform, a tree you climb into. Drawn as its model from the ground up.

approach.description: With `call`: squares. The prop speaks first, once, when the leader comes this close and can see it, before anyone uses it.

call.description: A dialogue ref (<file>:<node>) the prop speaks on its own when the party comes within `approach` squares (a vestige calling from its amber), once a game; `when` and `call_when` say when it may.

call_when.description: A condition: while it holds, the prop's `call` may play (not once the temple is sealed, or the talk was had).

skill.description: A search prop: the check that finds it (default perception; investigation for a compartment you work out). A search prop holding an item gets one try per character.

say.description: A Narrator trigger tried before examine:<id> (or search:<id>) when the prop is used: a camp's fire indoors says examine:camp_fire:indoors.

burning.description: A condition: while it holds, the prop burns (a big flame and light).

facing.description: Which way the piece's front looks (north is up the map), instead of away from the wall beside it or south: wagons round a fire, horses in a pen.

flame.description: The colour of the fire burning in the piece (a hearth's flame), as SetDressing.FLAME_TINTS has it: bile is a green fire, frost a cold white-blue one (the brazier room's).

span.description: [across, down]: a piece bigger than its square stands over the middle of this many squares, its own cell the north-west one (a wagon over its two-by-two block of low cover).

scale.description: How many times its modelled size its piece is drawn: a dragon's desk is three times a desk, its skull some twice the trophy it hangs among. The squares round it that it covers stay unfurnished (SetDressing.scaled_squares).

tint.description: Recolours its 3D piece: a palette colour's name or a "#rrggbb" colour its own colours are multiplied by (the dead colossus at the Amber Temple's doors, dark amber: ModelPiece.tint).

hangs.description: A chandelier hanging over `cells` (its piece is drawn up there): in a fight its chain can be broken to drop it on whoever is below (data/objects/kinds.json chandelier; world/combat/battle_scenery.gd). `trap`: the location trap that is this chandelier falling (sprung, it's down); `flag`: set once it has fallen (it's drawn lying on the floor from then on).

kind.description: Its kind in data/objects/kinds.json (chandelier by default).

lit.description: Its candles burn: falling, it sets oil under it alight.

object.description: What this prop is in a fight when its art alone doesn't say (a barrel of lamp oil): a kind in data/objects/kinds.json. Only a prop on a '=' square is a battlefield object (world/combat/battle_scenery.gd).

checks.description: Skill checks on this thing outside fights and conversations (story/world_checks.gd, docs/story/world_checks.md).

scale.description: How many times its modelled size its piece is drawn (the dragon's desk, three times a desk).

locked.description: Locked. With lock_dc 0 there's no lock to pick or force: it needs its key, magic, or `unlocked_when`.

unlocked_when.description: A lock the story takes off: the lid opens once this holds (Luvash's chest, once Arabelle is home).

owner.description: F8: the npc who owns it. Taking anything from it is stealing if somebody sees (docs/rules/stealth.md).

checks.description: Skill checks on this thing outside fights and conversations (story/world_checks.gd, docs/story/world_checks.md).

color.description: Optional: the light's palette colour (art/palette/palette.json), and a fire's flame in it where the flame has that tint ("bile": a green fire). Unset, candlelight.

visual.description: Only painted: the light is in the picture (LocationBuilder) but gives a fight no light zone, so the fights tuned on the place's old lamps see what they did. The Amber Temple's mood and amber glows.

sunlight.description: Its light is true sunlight in a fight (a sun painted on a vault, Tasha Petrovna's crypt): Sunlight Hypersensitivity and Sensitivity bite in its radius.

light_strings.description: Strings of lantern bulbs hung between two squares (LightString): every bulb glows and pools light on the ground, one real light in every `every` bulbs lights the figures. Only painted: no light zone in a fight.

height_ft.description: The ends' height above the ground (9).

every.description: A real light every so many bulbs (5).

condition_minutes.description: How long the condition lasts (minutes), as a lasting effect that runs out; with none, a minute for Frightened and ten for any other. Prone isn't timed: outside a fight the party stands up (world/exploration/location_care.gd).

pit_ft.description: A pit this many feet deep: shown as a hole once found or sprung; a failed save drops the victim in (falling damage plus the trap's), and they climb out with rope or a DC 15 Athletics check (world/exploration/pit_fall.gd).

model.description: The prop art a noticed trap shows (art/sprites/props); else picked by a word in its id or label (world/exploration/trap_sight.gd).

facing.description: Which way the NPC looks while standing (north is up the map).

approach.description: Squares: the NPC starts its dialogue once when the leader comes this close and can see them.

on.description: The id of a prop of this place the NPC stands on (the Amber Sentinel on its dais): the figure stands at the middle of its top, where the piece says (its `seat`), and still counts as on its own cell. Where the piece builds no seat (the Classic finish), they stand on the ground.

asleep.description: The NPC lies asleep here: Unconscious (so Incapacitated and Prone), drawn lying down, and the hover hint, Look and the Alt plates say so.

path.description: Waypoints the NPC walks from its cell, in order and back again: [x, y], [x, y, seconds to stand there], or {"at": [x, y], "wait": seconds, "face": direction, "work": "swing" or "gesture"} (a stop where they turn to their work: world/exploration/npc_routes.gd).

work.description: Standing in their place (or back home from their path), the NPC works at what they face: swings at it (an axe, a spade) or gestures over it (a stall, a sermon) every few seconds.

pause.description: Seconds the NPC stands at each waypoint of its path (default 3).

steps_aside.description: The figure keeps out of every fight on the map: it leaves the board as a fight begins and comes back after (a house's servants, who never stand in anyone's way: LocationNpcs.clear_for_fight).

hours.description: [from, to]: the NPC is here only between these hours (to may be past midnight, [19, 6]); with `when`, both must hold.

leads.description: A guide who leads without a word: Follow on the figure's menu while `when` holds, then the party follows it to `to` as `lead <npc> to <where>` does, and `flag` is set once it has.

side.description: enemy (the default), neutral, guest (on the party's side and moved by the player: a ward to get out) or ally (on the party's side as a guest the player controls: militia standing with the heroes).

hp.description: Overrides the stat block's Hit Points for this fight.

facing.description: F7: which way this foe faces while it waits in plain view before its fight (its sight cone points there). Unset: toward the middle of its group, else of its fight's area.

unseen.description: In a `waiting` fight, a foe not in plain view before it starts (among the casks): no figure, and it notices no one, until the fight puts it on its square.

art.description: The sprite this foe wears instead of its stat block's: a person fighting on a borrowed block (Vasilka on a flesh golem's).

boss.description: false: this foe isn't one of the game's bosses whatever its stat block (Difficulty.boss_entry): no boss bar, no boss damage or to-hit step (a lieutenant on a boss's block).

body.description: A body some damage ruins for good (a villager hollowed into a foe): when it drops to 0 Hit Points and any damage of a type in `ruined_by` landed in that blow, `flag` is set and 1 is added to the story flag `count`; `warn` shows on its tooltip and hover.

count.description: A story flag the fight adds 1 to for each body ruined.

warn.description: The warning its tooltip and hover show (whose body it is, and what ends it).

catch.description: A loose creature the heroes can catch (one of their attacks, as a grapple: it makes a Str or Dex save or is caught): it is carried out of the fight, and `flag` is set whatever the fight's outcome.

flag.description: The story flag set when it is caught.

steps_down.description: This foe is a person of the place (the Amber Sentinel on its dais): whichever way the fight starts, that person's figure leaves the board and the foe's takes its place, then strides to its start square (StepDown). Its stat block's size is untouched.

npc.description: The NPC id of the person whose place it takes.

states.description: Ids from the stat block's own `states` this fight puts the foe in, added to its traits (Sarkhaza chained or grave-salted; LocationFights.with_states).

ward.description: A creature the party must keep alive: if it falls, the fight is lost (ends_when.ward_lost); with ends_when.wards_out, getting every ward out by an open exit wins it. Usually on the guest side, so the player moves it.

rides.description: The `name` of another monster in this fight it starts the fight riding: it sits in that creature's space, carried when it moves, and the two act on the same Initiative count (each still takes its own turn). The rider needs a `name` too.

path.description: A patrol's round (a waiting fight's foe): the same waypoints as an NPC's path; it walks them before its fight, its sight cone turning with it, and the fight starts where it is (LocationStealth.tick_patrols).

nonlethal.description: Knocked out at 0 Hit Points, never killed (a charmed townsperson).

hostile_if_harmed.description: With side neutral: turns hostile once the party harms it or forces it to save.

innocent.description: A bystander the foes hunt (side neutral): enemies go for it, it fights nobody, the party counts it a friend.

waiting.description: F7: the foes stand in plain view before the fight (enter_area triggers only): they show once the party can see them, can notice the party, and can be attacked first (docs/rules/stealth.md).

loot.description: What the fight leaves when won (a loot window).

final_battle.description: ADR 0014: this is Strahd's fight in this Tarokka enemy room; the engine adds final_room:<room>, strahds_lair at foretold or later and not destroyed to `when`, and plays strahd/final:parley first.

lair.description: Lair actions on initiative count 20 for a monster that has them.

objects.description: Things the fight puts down itself (BattleScenery.for_spec, EncounterObjects.put): a boss's food, a jar holding a ghost. Each on its square while its `when` holds.

id.description: Its id in the fight (default thing_<n>).

when.description: A story condition: put down only while it holds.

model.description: The props catalog model the scene draws it with.

fuel.description: What a creature whose stat block `devours` this word eats (ObjectFuel).

releases.description: The creature that comes out when it breaks or is eaten (ObjectFuel.release).

minion_of.description: The stat block id of the boss it leaves with (BossPhases.fell).

threshold.description: Damage Threshold: damage less than this from one source does nothing to it (a captive's chains).

undo.description: A check that takes it off without breaking it by force: the Utilize action within 5 ft (ObjectActions.undo).

skill.description: The skill or ability checked (default athletics).

label.description: The verb on the hotbar (default Free).

flag.description: A story flag set when it is gone, broken or undone.

area.description: cells [[x, y]...], rect [x0, y0, x1, y1] (inclusive), or around [x, y] with radius (feet); none is the whole field.

dc_from.description: The save's DC from the story: base + step x the flag's value, set as the fight starts.

dc_step.description: Added to the DC for each time the event has acted before.

say.description: A Narrator key the view says as it acts.

until_flag.description: It stops once the fight has set this flag (a fire put out in the fight).

pick.description: random (never the same twice running), cycle (in turn, round and round) or sequence (each once in turn, then nothing).

area.description: cells [[x, y]...], rect [x0, y0, x1, y1] (inclusive), or around [x, y] with radius (feet); none is the whole field.

dc_from.description: The save's DC from the story: base + step x the flag's value, set as the fight starts.

dc_step.description: Added to the DC for each time the event has acted before.

say.description: A Narrator key the view says as it acts.

modifiers.description: Rule changes on whoever it lands on, with or instead of a condition.

repeat_save.description: The save again at the end of each of the creature's turns; a success ends it.

unless_count.description: Only while fewer than at_least of the creatures named in who (names or stat block ids) stand.

who.description: take: the names or stat-block ids it may take, the first still on the board each time.

narration.description: take: the line the view shows as the creature goes (the blue mist).

one.description: It strikes one creature it reaches, picked at random (a neutral one too, with affects all).

modifiers.description: Rule changes on whoever it lands on, with or instead of a condition.

repeat_save.description: The save again at the end of each of the creature's turns; a success ends it.

unless_count.description: Only while fewer than at_least of the creatures named in who (names or stat block ids) stand.

items.description: Round events (combat/round_events.gd): something that happens on initiative count `at` with no creature behind it, in the rounds it says; as itself, or one entry of `table` each time.

withdraw.description: A foe leaves the fight (no loot, no death) below `at_hp_below` Hit Points or after `after_rounds` rounds, setting `flag`, saying `say` as it goes.

say.description: A line it speaks as it goes, in the voice of `speaker`; the fight waits for it before it ends.

speaker.description: Whose voice speaks `say` (an npc id, as in the conversations).

rearm_minutes.description: Once won, the fight comes back after this many minutes of the clock (a beaten mob gathers again): LocationFights.rearm.

ends_when.description: Ways the fight ends with no winner (outcome "ended": no victory flag, no loot, the fight not done, so a waiting foe waits again as its entry says, asleep with `surprise: enemies`). Any one that holds ends it.

party_left_map.description: A hero who ends their turn on one of the place's open exits steps out of the fight; once no hero who is up is left on the board, it ends.

trigger_hero_down.description: It ends when the first hero to hurt a foe in it drops to 0 Hit Points.

flag.description: A story flag set when it ends this way.

clear_flags.description: Story flags cleared when it ends this way (the flag that woke a sleeper, so it can be woken again).

rounds.description: A clock: the fight ends as this round ends, with rounds_outcome; the HUD counts the rounds left.

rounds_outcome.description: What the clock running out means: victory (the party held out), defeat, ended (the default: no winner) or none (only a countdown: the flag is set and the fight goes on).

rounds_flag.description: A flag set for the story when the clock runs out.

foes_end_it.description: False: beating the foes (or having none) doesn't end the fight; only its clock, objects, wards or meters do (a rite with no one to fight).

rounds_label.description: What the clock counts down to, for the HUD ("The mill falls").

wards_out.description: The fight is won once every ward (a monster entry's `ward`) has ended a turn on one of the place's open exits and left.

ward_lost.description: What a ward falling means: defeat (the default) or ended (no winner).

objects_gone.description: Object ids (the fight's `objects`): once every one is broken or undone, the fight ends with objects_outcome.

objects_outcome.description: What getting rid of them all means: victory (the default) or ended.

meters_needed.description: Meters that must reach their value as well as the foes beaten before the fight is won (a rite's six successes and its guardians dead).

meters_outcome.description: What the fight ends with once the needed meters are full and the foes are down: victory (the default) or ended.

allies_block.description: In this fight, party members can't move through each other's spaces (default: they can, as Difficult Terrain).

meters.description: Counts the fight is about, shown on the HUD (FightMeters): a guide's loyalty, a rite's pips. The heroes move them with their actions; reaching a mark sets a flag or ends the fight.

on.description: Fight events that move it: [{event: defeat, crit or failed_save, who: [names or stat blocks], side: party or enemy, delta}].

near.description: An object id or a creature's name it must be done beside.

check.description: {skill, dc}, or {skills: [...], dc} (the hero's best of them), or {any_skill: true, dc}. None: it simply works.

failure_damage.description: {dice, type}; type may be a list, one rolled each time.

rescue.description: On a success the creature named in `near` nearest the hero, within `range`, is out of the fight, saved.

when.description: A story condition: the action is offered only if it holds as the fight starts.

advantage_when.description: A story condition: the check has Advantage if it holds as the fight starts (a theme the party remembers).

brilliant.description: A success by `by` (5) or more also moves this meter by 1.

failure_event.description: A burst on a failure: {affects, area, save: {ability, dc}, damage: {dice, type}, condition (until the end of the target's next turn), instead: {damage: {dice, type}} (a hero who failed may take this rather than the condition)}.

take.description: Names or stat blocks the mark frees: out of the fight, rescued.

store.description: A story flag set to the meter's value as the fight ends.

start_from.description: {flag, table: [[at least, add]...]}: added to start from a story flag as the fight starts.

store_add.description: Add the value to the story flag instead (a tally kept across fights).

pips.description: The HUD draws the count as pips up to max.

menu.description: Its actions fold under one hotbar entry of this name (a rite's Honour the Fallen).

object_rules.description: Set-piece rules for things the scenery made from the place's props (BattleScenery.for_spec, ObjectCarry): a brazier on the map given a hazard, things to put in it.

openings.description: Openings a creature can be thrown out of (FightOpenings): a creature with a `throws_out` trait throws a held foe by one out of it; the foe falls the drop and climbs back in on its turn.

flag.description: A fight flag: while it is set, the drop is this one's.

free_fall.description: Everyone falls together on one plane (a pit with no bottom): nobody flies up or down, levitates or teleports (Encounter.free_fall).

portals.description: Paired squares that lead into each other (FightPortals): a creature stepping onto one, walking or pushed, comes out on the other and its move ends.

when_flag.description: Only while this fight flag is set.

broken.description: Only once the object the scenery made from this prop is broken (a window).

nonlethal.description: Nobody dies in this fight (a brawl): whoever drops to 0 Hit Points is knocked out.

defeat.description: Losing this fight means being taken, not killed (DefeatCapture): the outcome is captured, the fallen heroes come round at hp, `set` flags are stamped with the minute, and the party is jailed (Jail) or moved there.

jail.description: <location>[:<spawn>]: locked up there (gear kept by the jailers unless keep_gear).

until.description: jail: a condition that lets the party out.

hp.description: The Hit Points the fallen come round at (1).

set.description: Flags set to the minute the party was taken (for a clock, days_since).

say.description: A Narrator key for the moment (default combat:captured).

floor.description: The floor of a building or dungeon this map is on (Castle Ravenloft's: ground, court, tower, larders, catacombs). The enemies of a floor are the ones that keep a Long Rest from starting on it (RestRules.rest_maps); the building's other floors don't. A map without one is part of the whole building.

recheck_minutes.description: Re-check who stands where and which props show every this many game minutes (a place that changes by the minute: a `when` reading `minutes_since`), besides each hour.

rest.description: Whether a Long Rest is possible here (risky: 1 in 6 to be interrupted).

rest_text.description: Why resting isn't possible (shown when rest is 'no').

treasure_spots.description: Tarokka places this location holds (ADR 0011): place id (data/tarokka/outcomes.json) -> the container, fight or conversation where the treasure the reading put there is found.

allies_block.description: Party members can't move through each other's spaces anywhere in this location.

wall_styles.description: Wall squares built in a style of their own (docs/art/interiors.md): every wall square inside `cells` ([corner, corner]), with `plinth` the steps a statue stands on, otherwise painted wood in the palette colour `paint`, with a band of `trim` along its outer faces and, with `wheels`, cart wheels on its long sides. Rictavio's carnival wagon in the Blue Water Inn's yard.

plinth.description: The block is a plinth, not a wall: three low steps of the temple's black stone under a statue (FacelessGod), the squares still blocking. Modern finish only.

fortress.description: A Daern's Instant Fortress already standing on this map (Strahd's, in the treasury): its 4 x 4 plot's north-west square `cell`, the door's square `door` on the `looks` face and the open square `front` before it, as story/fortress_site.gd keeps them for the party's own tower. The plot must already be solid wall in `map.rows` (the tower is drawn over it); its door is an exit named fortress_entry (docs/story/fortress.md).

hazard.description: Air that harms whoever stays here, on the exploration clock (PlaceHazards): a save on entering and every `every_min` minutes, a condition, then saves every `lasting.every_min` minutes that add Exhaustion until one succeeds.

when.description: A story condition: the air is bad only while it holds.

fight_rules.description: The place's own rules in every fight there (Encounter.place_rules): modifiers on every creature in the fight, gone with it (a jinxed riverboat: crits on 19-20, misses on 1-2, music against Concentration).

rest_when.description: Story-dependent rest rules (RestRules.rule_of): the first whose `when` holds replaces `rest` (and `rest_text`), as a village's one house the mob fears lets the party sleep while the town hunts it.

lying.description: Owner 2026-10-13 (the text has Vasilka lying under a sheet, very still; she stood beside her table): the figure lies down here with no condition (LyingFigures), until the entry changes or, for a foe, its fight opens and it gets up. true, or {on, head, sheet, pose, lift}. A person lies on their back on their own square, on top of the furniture standing there, or on the prop `on` names (a bier beside them), head along the furniture or toward `head`; `sheet` lays linen over them to the chest or over the face. A beast or a dragon lies on its belly, low on the ground (`pose` back or belly says otherwise). `lift` sets how high it lies instead of the top of what it lies on. `picture` names a drawing of the figure lying down (art/sprites/lying/<id>.png: Sarkhaza across her gold) that stands in for it until it gets up; until that drawing exists, the figure lies as it would without one.

check.description: A skill check on a thing in the world (story/world_checks.gd): the party's best hand at it who hasn't tried rolls on the big d20; each character gets one try (`once`: one for the party); a party member proficient in the skill Helps (Advantage) unless it's done `alone`; Guidance adds 1d4. The Narrator's line for how it went is `check:<skill>:<id>:success` or `:failure` (else the outcome's `text`). An encounter here whose trigger is `check:<id>:success` or `:failure` starts when it goes that way.

id.description: Unique in the location; names its Narrator lines and its record.

label.description: What trying it is, for the menu: "Read the claw marks".

when.description: Offered only while this condition holds.

once.description: One try for the whole party: a failure spends it (a crumbling ledge, a rune that burns out).

alone.description: Nobody can Help: only one can do it (a narrow ledge, a whisper only the reader hears).

minutes.description: How long a try takes (1 by default).

outcome.description: What a check's success or failure does. Items and harm go to whoever rolled.

text.description: Said when the Narrator has no line for it.

flag.description: A side flag (registered in data/flags/world_checks.json, so a check never moves the main story).

inspiration.description: Whoever rolled gains Heroic Inspiration (passed on if they have it).

heal.description: Dice each hurt party member regains (a clean spring, a poultice).

temp_hp.description: Dice of Temporary Hit Points for each party member.

damage.description: Dice of damage to whoever rolled (a fall, a shock).

minutes.description: Time lost on top of the try.

reveal.description: Hidden things brought to light: a search prop, secret door or trap here, or <location>:<search prop> elsewhere (a place hint).

open.description: Doors here opened (a shortcut: a bar lifted from the far side).

move.description: The party crosses to this square (a climb, a leap, a squeeze).

set_piece_carry.description: A plain thing a hero carries (ObjectCarry): no Hit Points or Armor Class, can't be attacked; taken with the object interaction within 5 ft.

tag.description: What it is, for the things that take it.

set_piece_takes.description: What it takes in (ObjectCarry.put): the Utilize action within 5 ft by a hero carrying a thing with this tag. Cleansed: its hazard ends.

label.description: The verb on the hotbar (default Put it in).

flag.description: A fight flag set when something goes in.

say.description: A log line when something goes in.

who.description: Creature names or stat block ids.

disadvantage.description: Creature names or stat block ids.

color.description: A hex colour for the light.

light.description: A warding light round it: the creatures named in `disadvantage` have Disadvantage on D20 Tests within `radius` ft.

set_piece_hazard.description: Its hazards (ObjectCarry.hazards), once a turn each: entering a square within `near_ft` (on: enter; 0 = its own squares) or ending a turn there (on: end) means the save or `exhaustion` and `damage`.

if_flag.description: Only while this fight flag is set (a boss phase's `flag`).

unless_flag.description: Only while this fight flag is unset.

set_piece_study.description: The Study action within 30 ft: the best of `skills` (default investigation) tells what it is (`say`) and sets `flag`.
